{{Otheruses|Ordnance and Supply}}
The '''Chief of Ordnance and Supply''' was the [[Supreme Allied Commanders|Supreme Allied Commander]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Ordnance and Supply/Legends|Ordnance and Supply]] department.<ref name="RASB">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Ral'Rai Muvunc]] served as the head of Ordnance and Supply.<ref name="J2">{{JournalCite|2|Rebel Privateers!}}</ref>
